tools.name: exchange_rates
tools.description: Get currency exchange rates (blended across providers). With base and quote it returns the rate for one pair (optional date). Without quote it returns rates for a base: latest by default, a historical day with date, or a time series with start_date/end_date (downsample with group). Use quotes to filter targets, expand=providers for per-provider rates.

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: Base currency code, e.g. EUR.

parameters.name: quote
parameters.description: Quote currency code for a single pair, e.g. USD. When given, returns one pair's rate (use base too).

parameters.name: quotes
parameters.description: Comma-separated target currency codes, e.g. USD,GBP. Used when quote is not given.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date of a historical rate, YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date of a time series, YYYY-MM-DD. Not used with quote.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End date of a time series, YYYY-MM-DD. Not used with quote.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Downsample a time series: week or month.

parameters.name: providers
parameters.description: Restrict rates to a provider or dataset key, e.g. ecb.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Set to providers to add per-provider rates to each row. Not used with quote.

tools.name: provider_rates
tools.description: Get rates directly from one specific provider (e.g. ecb). With base and quote it returns a single pair's rate. Otherwise it returns rates for the provider, with optional date, a time series (start_date/end_date), grouping, base and quotes filters.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider key, e.g. ecb.

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: Base currency code, e.g. EUR.

parameters.name: quote
parameters.description: Quote currency code for a single pair, e.g. USD. Use together with base.

parameters.name: quotes
parameters.description: Comma-separated target currency codes, e.g. USD,GBP. Used when quote is not given.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date of the rate, YYYY-MM-DD. Not used with quote.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date of a time series, YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End date of a time series, YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Downsample a time series: week or month.

parameters.name: providers
parameters.description: Restrict rates to a provider or dataset key, e.g. ecb.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Set to providers to add per-provider rates to each row.

tools.name: currencies
tools.description: Look up currencies and their provider coverage. With currency it returns details for that one currency; without it, lists all available currencies (scope=all includes legacy currencies).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency code, e.g. EUR. Omit to list all currencies.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Set to all to include legacy currencies when listing.

tools.name: providers
tools.description: Look up the data providers behind the API. With provider it returns details including its datasets; without it, lists all providers.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider key, e.g. ecb. Omit to list all providers.

excluded.reason: Non-JSON CSV response with no parameters; duplicates the rates data available as JSON.
